The '''Second Duel in the Jedi Temple''' was a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] between the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ferus Olin]], in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Entering the Temple==
Entering the Temple through a rooftop [[Jedi Temple refectory/Legends|breakfast room]], Olin accessed a stairwell from a ruined [[Jedi Temple/Legends|atrium]] at the base of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]] and climbed to the [[High Council holomap room/Legends|Jedi Temple Map Room]]. There, he accessed its data banks, where he discovered evidence of a partnership between Darth Vader and [[Eve Yarrow|Flame]], a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who was supposed to be helping Olin. Deleting the message Flame had left for Vader, Olin made his way back down to the atrium where he encountered Vader.

==The duel==
As they began the duel, Olin held his own. Because all of the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] were powered down, Olin was forced onto the stairs leading up to the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]]. In the once pristine room, the two dueled around the chairs, now rubble in the circular chamber. As the wind whipped back Vader's cape, Olin threw [[Dun Möch/Legends|taunts]] at the Sith Lord, distracting him enough for the former Jedi to land a blow on the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg's]] control panel. [[Telekinesis/Legends|Throwing]] blackened furniture, floor tiles and conduits from the ceiling at Olin, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] attempted to force him from the chamber out the shattered windows.

The [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] Olin carried in his tunic pocket encouraged him to strike Vader down and become [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]; however, as Olin was pinned against the wall after a misstep, he was filled with the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]], as if the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] were once again in the Chamber. Overcome by the goodness left in the ruins, Olin leapt over Vader and dove through a hole in the floor, dropping several stories into the Map Room. Racing down through the Tower, he headed for the Temple's power core, where the residual energies within were enough to destroy the holocron and its evil energies.

Vader found Ferus in the Core, yet before he struck the final blow, he raced out of the Temple on the orders of his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] to see to the destruction of the [[Jedi asteroid]].
